observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A stage performance in a large indoor venue, likely a church or concert hall, with a choir and audience.
observation.dancers: A large group of mixed men and women, including choir members and audience members.
observation.formation_and_space: The choir is in a line formation on stage; audience members are in rows of seats, some standing and moving in place.
observation.posture: Upright torso, knees slightly bent, weight shifting from side to side.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping, shifting weight between feet, often on the beat; precise footwork is difficult to see due to camera angles and lighting.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms are often raised, sometimes with hands open or holding microphones or small handheld props (like a whisk/fly whisk); some clapping.
observation.hips_and_torso: Slight hip swaying and torso movement, often in sync with the rhythm.
observation.partnering: None; individuals dance independently or in loose groups.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Mostly at one level, with occasional slight knee bends; no significant jumps or complex turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Choir members wear white tops with patterned skirts or trousers; some hold small handheld whisks.
observation.cannot_infer: Low-resolution video and stage lighting make it difficult to see precise footwork or subtle weight transfers.

signature_moments.what: The choir members on stage perform a rhythmic, side-to-side weight shift while holding microphones and small whisks, moving their arms in a gentle, swaying motion.
